description: This file defines the StoreQuery class, which manages storing, loading, and manipulating user-specific search queries and preferences within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for saving queries from request data, clearing stored queries, loading stored queries, and formatting date and number fields appropriately before saving.

classes.name: StoreQuery
classes.description: A class handling the storage, retrieval, and management of user search queries and their related parameters in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: addToQuery
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the internal query array.

methods.name: SaveQuery
methods.description: Saves the current query parameters to the user preferences, performing necessary data conversions.

methods.name: clearQuery
methods.description: Clears the stored query and saves the empty state.

methods.name: loadQuery
methods.description: Loads a stored query for a given name from user preferences.

methods.name: populateRequest
methods.description: Populates $_REQUEST and $_GET with the stored query values, converting dates and numbers for display.

methods.name: getSaveType
methods.description: Determines the save type configuration for a given query name.

methods.name: saveFromRequest
methods.description: Saves query data from the $_REQUEST superglobal, handling clear commands and different save types.

methods.name: saveFromGet
methods.description: Saves query data from the $_GET superglobal, handling clear commands and save type logic.

methods.name: getStoredQueryForUser
methods.description: Static method returning the stored query array for a user for a specific module.
